Type: deco
Name: Pinzon Fleur Jacquard Egyptian Cotton Sateen Window Drape, Set of 2, Taupe/Cream
Colors: Taupe/Cream
Materials: Egyptian-Cotton
Set of 2 window drapes with a jacquard floral pattern; 2 tie-backs included; made in Portugal Made of 100-percent Egyptian cotton in a 300-thread-count sateen weave; matching valance sold separately 4 standard rod pockets along top; bottom corners mitered and weighted for elegant look and proper hang Machine wash cool and tumble dry low; coordinates with Pinzon Fleur Jacquard collection Each panel measures 50 by 84 inches
